groups.cause: Main request waiting + redirected attention + minor work lacks V72 explicit required-response cue.

groups.cause: Later-than-normal/delayed answer/response + one review + explicit closure variants are partly uncovered and can leak to ignore.
groups.bounded_fix: Expand delayed/single-review/closure cue sets; keep slow before ignore.

groups.cause: Came close/got ready/nearly acted, identical/same analysis/reasoning, and no-new-input/evidence-unchanged variants miss V72 sequence conjunction.
groups.bounded_fix: Broaden each required component while preserving approach+retreat+return/reopen+same-review+repetition+no-new-information structure.

groups.cause: Parent route can interpret selected/step language as delegated decision despite explicit myself + carried it out + no restart.
groups.bounded_fix: Add narrow neutral-completion guard requiring self-authorship + completed execution + closure/no-reopen, overriding route/families to self-lived neutral only when all three are present.
